about: Each world body's sky and indoor air, as the scene-record stage writes them into a place's record (score/stages/scene_record): what a room's air holds and how the camera is exposed. Unverified seed numbers: these are the values every Moon room's old record held (the game's sky and fill), kept here once instead of in each record until the light stage's sweep against each place's concept sets them.

indoor.from: seed: the indoor environment, haze and room fill every Moon room's old scene record held alike (airlock, garage, greenhouse, habitat, lab, workshop, hangar, hub), not yet measured against a concept

earth.about: The Earth's launch night round the prologue's places, in the street's frame (EarthSite's own: x across the block, -x toward the harbour, z along the street, y up from the street), which the made ground's seats stand in each place's frame. Unverified seed numbers: what the old records of the flat, stairwell, street, square and launch view held alike, not yet measured against a concept.

night.from: seed: the night sky, ambient, exposure, haze ring and stars the street's and the flat's old records held

moonlight.name: moonlight
moonlight.from: seed: the full Moon's light every Earth place's old record held

moon.from: seed: the Moon over the rocket as the old records held it, seen from the flat's balcony (its eye)

kit_glow.from: seed: how the night lights a kit's glowing kinds, as the outdoor places' old records held it

harbour.from: seed: the harbour's reach from the quay (x -110) out to the old far disc's 320 m, and how its water mirrors the lit rocket, as the old records held it

tube_light.from: seed: the flat's room lamp, dim (the concept draws the tube off: the light stage's sweep decides)

door_canopy.from: seed: the lamp under the street door's canopy

shop_open.from: seed: the barber's open shop's glow

far_lectern.from: seed: the stage lamp on the speaker, 2.4 m in front of the lectern and 1.08 m over its middle

far_pad_floodlight.from: seed: the rocket's floodlight, on each of the pad's floodlights
